description: In every model \(M\models Q\), for every element \(a\) and external natural number \(n\), either \(a=\overline m\) for some \(m\le n\), or \(\overline n<a\) under the abbreviation \(x<y\iff\exists z\,(z+Sx=y)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeral_cut.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
  (∃ m ≤ n, a = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M m) ∨
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M (n + 1)) a
